name: kyte
description: Your company's kyte workspace in Codex: customers, contacts, deals, projects, hours, invoices, goals, people and documents — read and changed as you, under your permissions. Served by the kyte program on your own computer.

interface.shortDescription: Your company workspace: customers, projects, hours, invoices
interface.longDescription: kyte is the company OS by Pirol Labs. This plugin serves your workspace to Codex through the kyte program on your own computer: look up customers, projects, hours, invoices, goals and people, log time, create a customer, update a deal. It works as you and under your permissions — what your role may not see does not exist for it, and what your role may not change it cannot change. Needs the kyte command line, installed and signed in once.
